cards.ex: She really has a way with words; her speeches are always so moving.
cards.exUz: Uning so'zga chechanligi bor; nutqlari har doim juda ta'sirli.
cards.term: to have a way with words
cards.uzDef: Gapirishda yoki yozishda juda mahoratli bo'lish, ta'sirchan ifodalash.

cards.ex: I can't make head nor tail of these instructions; they're so confusing!
cards.exUz: Men bu ko'rsatmalarga umuman tushunmayapman; ular juda chalkash!
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni umuman tushunmaslik, anglay olmaslik.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss the project's progress.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi hafta loyihaning borishi haqida gaplashish uchun aloqada bo'lamiz.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida aloqada bo'lish, yangiliklardan xabar olish.

cards.ex: That documentary gave me a lot of food for thought about environmental issues.
cards.exUz: Bu hujjatli film menga atrof-muhit muammolari haqida o'ylash uchun ko'p narsa berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylashga, muhokama qilishga arziydigan fikr yoki g'oya.

cards.ex: We need to make sure everyone's on the same page before we start the presentation.
cards.exUz: Taqdimotni boshlashdan oldin hamma bir fikrda ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilishimiz kerak.
cards.term: to be on the same page
cards.uzDef: Bir xil tushunchaga ega bo'lish, kelishilgan fikrda bo'lish.

cards.ex: In a nutshell, the meeting was productive but exhausting.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, yig'ilish samarali, lekin charchatuvchi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa va aniq qilib aytganda, asosiy mazmunini berish.

cards.ex: I had to spell out the instructions for him because he wasn't understanding.
cards.exUz: U tushunmagani uchun, men unga ko'rsatmalarni batafsil tushuntirib berishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Batafsil tushuntirib berish, hamma narsani aniq qilib aytish.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project by assigning tasks.
cards.exUz: Keling, vazifalarni belgilash orqali ushbu loyihani boshlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlash, harakatga keltirish.

cards.ex: She's really good at putting her ideas across in a clear and concise way.
cards.exUz: U o'z g'oyalarini aniq va qisqa tarzda yetkazishda juda yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Fikrni, ma'lumotni aniq va tushunarli tarzda yetkazish.

cards.ex: We were talking at cross-purposes because I thought he meant something else.
cards.exUz: Biz bir-birimizni noto'g'ri tushundik, chunki men u boshqa narsani nazarda tutayapti deb o'yladim.
cards.uzDef: Notog'ri tushunish tufayli bir-biri bilan kelishmaslik, adashish.

cards.ex: The instructions were crystal clear, so I had no trouble assembling the furniture.
cards.exUz: Ko'rsatmalar juda aniq edi, shuning uchun men mebelni yig'ishda hech qanday qiyinchilikka duch kelmadim.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubha yoki chalkashliksiz, juda tushunarli.

cards.ex: I heard straight from the horse's mouth that she's getting promoted.
cards.exUz: Uning lavozimi ko'tarilayotganini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri manbadan eshitdim.
cards.term: to hear something straight from the horse's mouth
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri manbadan, ishonchli odamdan eshitish.

cards.ex: We must have got our wires crossed; I thought the meeting was tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Biz adashgan bo'lishimiz kerak; Men yig'ilish ertaga deb o'yladim.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri tushunish natijasida chalkashib ketmoq, adashmoq.

cards.ex: He repeated the message word for word, so I knew he was serious.
cards.exUz: U xabarni so'zma-so'z takrorladi, shuning uchun men uning jiddiy ekanligini bildim.
cards.uzDef: Har bir so'zni aynan takrorlab, o'zgartirmasdan aytish.

cards.ex: He's been out of touch with the latest trends in technology.
cards.exUz: U texnologiyadagi so'nggi tendentsiyalardan bexabar.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa haqida ma'lumotga ega bo'lmaslik, xabardor bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: I really put my foot in it when I asked her about her ex-husband.
cards.exUz: Men unga sobiq eri haqida savol berganimda, men haqiqatan ham bejirim gapirdim.
cards.term: to put your foot in it
cards.uzDef: Noqulay vaziyatga tushishga olib keladigan narsani aytish yoki qilish.

cards.ex: I heard on the grapevine that they're planning to merge the two departments.
cards.exUz: Mish-mishlarga ko'ra, ular ikki bo'limni birlashtirishni rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy bo'lmagan tarzda, mish-mishlar orqali tarqalgan xabar.

cards.ex: 'Break a leg' is just a figure of speech, meaning 'good luck'.
cards.exUz: 'Omad tilayman' shunchaki ko'chma ma'no, ya'ni 'omadingizni bersin'.
cards.uzDef: So'zning to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ma'nosidan farqli ravishda ishlatilishi.

cards.ex: Using visual aids can help you get your point across more effectively.
cards.exUz: Vizual vositalardan foydalanish fikringizni yanada samaraliroq yetkazishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Fikringizni boshqalarga tushunarli qilib yetkazish.

cards.ex: The politician was being economical with the truth about his finances.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi o'z moliyasi haqida rostni kamaytirayotgan edi.
cards.term: to be economical with the truth
cards.uzDef: To'liq rostni aytmaslik, yolg'onni yashirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I need to see the agreement in black and white before I sign anything.
cards.exUz: Nimaga imzo chekishdan oldin kelishuvni qora va oq rangda ko'rishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yozma ravishda, chop etilgan holda, aniq va shubhasiz.

cards.ex: At the end of the day, what matters is that we tried our best.
cards.exUz: Oxir-oqibatda, muhimi shundaki, biz qo'limizdan kelganicha harakat qildik.
cards.term: at the end of the day
cards.uzDef: Muhokama qilinayotgan vaziyatning eng muhim jihati.

cards.ex: I don't want to air my dirty laundry in public, so let's talk about this in private.
cards.exUz: Men o'z shaxsiy muammolarimni omma oldida muhokama qilmoqchi emasman, shuning uchun bu haqda shaxsiy suhbatlashamiz.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy muammolarini omma oldida muhokama qilmoq.

cards.ex: This job offer is a golden opportunity to advance my career.
cards.exUz: Bu ish taklifi mening faoliyatimni rivojlantirish uchun oltin imkoniyatdir.
cards.uzDef: Qo'ldan boy berib bo'lmaydigan, juda yaxshi imkoniyat.

cards.ex: Can I run my presentation by you before I give it to the team?
cards.exUz: Taqdimotni jamoaga berishdan oldin sizga ko'rsatsam maylimi?
cards.uzDef: Fikr yoki rejalarni boshqalarga ko'rsatib baho olish.

cards.ex: I think you've got the wrong end of the stick; I wasn't criticizing you.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, siz noto'g'ri tushundingiz; Men sizni tanqid qilmagan edim.
cards.term: get the wrong end of the stick
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni noto'g'ri tushunib, noto'g'ri xulosaga kelish.

cards.ex: You could hear a pin drop in the room when the CEO announced the layoffs.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor ishdan bo'shatishni e'lon qilganida, xonada jimjitlik hukm surdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda jim, hatto ignaning tushishi ham eshitiladigan darajada.

cards.ex: In a word, the performance was spectacular.
cards.exUz: Bir so'z bilan aytganda, ijro ajoyib edi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqacha aytganda, bir so'z bilan ifodalash.

cards.ex: I want to be up front with you: there are some challenges we need to address.
cards.exUz: Men siz bilan ochiq bo'lishni xohlayman: biz hal qilishimiz kerak bo'lgan ba'zi muammolar bor.
cards.uzDef: Rostgo'y, ochiq, yashirmasdan gapirish.

cards.ex: To put it bluntly, the project is a disaster.
cards.exUz: Ochiq aytganda, loyiha halokatga uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq, to'g'ri so'z bilan aytish, muloyimlikni chetlab o'tish.
